program_score.source_weights: Paper4 frozen strict one-to-one human ortholog weights
program_score.score_definition: mean(sign_weight * standardized_gene_expression) over available strict genes
program_score.missing_strict_gene_policy: FAIL_CLOSED; no reduced-gene fallback in the primary analysis

case_matching.required_overlap: all 78 frozen Paper5 cases exactly once
case_matching.extra_Paper4_cases: ignored after exact 78-case subset is identified

primary_alignment.per_coordinate_metric: Spearman correlation between frozen program score and frozen V1 shared coordinate
primary_alignment.reason_for_absolute_value: V1 latent-axis sign is arbitrary; magnitude is the invariant alignment quantity.

matched_random_program_controls.gene_universe: genes present in the frozen Paper4 TARGET expression file after exact 78-case subset; finite and positive ddof1 variance
matched_random_program_controls.exclude_genes: union of strict genes from M34, M40, M11, M24
matched_random_program_controls.matching_variable: pre-standardization sample variance across the exact 78-case TARGET frame
matched_random_program_controls.binning_rule: deterministic equal-frequency variability bins with original gene symbol as deterministic tie-break
matched_random_program_controls.sampling_rule: same-bin preference; without replacement within each random panel
matched_random_program_controls.fallback_rule: if same-bin candidates are insufficient, expand symmetrically to nearest variability bins; record every fallback draw
matched_random_program_controls.panel_size: exact strict-gene count of the corresponding frozen program
matched_random_program_controls.weight_and_sign_rule: carry the frozen anchor gene sign/weight positions onto the matched sampled genes so each null preserves the anchor score-weight distribution
matched_random_program_controls.null_statistic: maximum absolute Spearman correlation across the same five frozen V1 shared coordinates
matched_random_program_controls.selection_correction: the null also maximizes over five coordinates, matching the observed best-coordinate search
matched_random_program_controls.matched_random_results_are: specificity/context evidence, not proof that a coordinate is biological

multiplicity.family: four primary Paper4 program-level matched-random empirical probabilities

next_stage.required: separate versioned biological runner with synthetic/schema preflight and source authorization before first biological-result computation
next_stage.future_runner_first_action: verify exact SHA-256 of every frozen biological input before parsing any scientific row/value
next_stage.post_result_contract_changes: FORBIDDEN; any scientifically necessary amendment requires a new versioned pre-result contract and preservation of this contract
